items.title: Google Search Ad Visits Out-Earned ChatGPT Ads In U.S.
items.excerpt: Data finds ChatGPT ad visits brought advertisers a fraction of paid search's revenue per visit in U.S. traffic ($0.89 vs $2.45), and most saw no sales from them.

history_match.title: ChatGPT Traffic Drop Appears To Be A Tracking Problem

items.title: 3 AI Models Shopped Shopify's Catalog – Each Picked A Different Winner
items.excerpt: Three Claude models picked from the same 20 Shopify products 1,980 times and never agreed on the top product; the test breaks down what decided the AI shopping agents' picks.

history_match.title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents

items.title: Google Using AI-Generated Fake Google Ads Strategist Names & Profile Photos
items.excerpt: Google Ads Strategists in Google's Extended Workforce are contacting advertisers under AI-generated names and profile photos, an advertiser found when the sender's identity couldn't be traced.

history_match.title: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads

items.title: Amazon says more than 400M customers have used Alexa for Shopping in the last 12 months
items.excerpt: On its Q3 call Amazon said shoppers using its conversational AI shopping assistant spend 50% more per order; the assistant carries sponsored prompts while Amazon blocks outside agents like ChatGPT and Meta's Muse.

history_match.title: Walmart Embraces AI Agents That Shop on Behalf of Customers

items.title: Google search loses its free pass with buyers
items.excerpt: AI Overviews and AI Mode are cutting click-through, search ad revenue growth slowed to 12% in Q3, and media buyers are now questioning whether Google search budgets should move elsewhere.

items.title: AI Labels Don't Tell Consumers Whether An Ad's Claims Are Real
items.excerpt: A generic 'made with AI' label tells consumers AI was used to build an ad but leaves them guessing where reality ends and fiction begins; the column argues disclosure must address the claims themselves.

history_match.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads

items.title: After AI backlash, Svedka challenges consumers to create Super Bowl ad
items.excerpt: After its AI-produced Super Bowl LX spot drew controversy, Svedka is handing its next big-game ad to consumers via a $500,000 contest, with a toolkit allowing 'AI-led' entries.

items.title: Google tells advertisers AI search queries now run 3x longer
items.excerpt: One in six searches is now multimodal and AI search queries run three times longer, Google's Shivani Mohan told advertisers; PPC Land notes Google's May data limited that to US AI Mode and asks which figures lack a baseline.

items.title: Marketers still spend 10 hours a week on manual optimization, DV finds
items.excerpt: DoubleVerify's survey of 2,020 marketers in 25 countries finds third-party AI bidding use rose to 50% from 42%, yet manual campaign optimization fell by only 14 minutes a week.
